title: fix: install ripgrep in Polli runtime image
author: Itachi-1824
pr_body_excerpt:
- Installs ripgrep in the Polli runtime image so `code_search` can run its exact-match step.
- Fixes `grep` and combined `search` failing when the `rg` executable is missing.
- Verified a repaired production image with nine handler checks, including semantic/exact search and no-match grep; the bot reconnected and both containers are healthy.

gist.headline: Polli finds the missing grep
gist.blurb: Polli’s toolbox gets ripgrep. Exact-match code search, grep, and combined search have the executable they need.
gist.summary: Installs ripgrep in Polli’s runtime image so code_search can run exact matches and the grep and combined search handlers work.
gist.impact: Polli can complete semantic and exact code searches, including grep searches that find no matches, without failing on a missing rg executable.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli finding a missing search tool in a cozy coding workshop: a small ripgrep-labeled magnifying glass beside a CRT terminal showing code, with code-plants growing nearby. A friendly monitor robot can help hold the search results.
